annotations.title: Find anchorages near a position, tonight or in a wind

description: Lists the places near a position where boats stopped, overnight or by day, with where boats stayed in tonight's forecast there or in a given wind. For tonight, call it without wind_from and wind_kn: the answer then carries tonight's forecast at the position and each place's nights in each of tonight's winds, as the site's Tonight does. Give a wind only to ask about that wind. Each place comes with how far and which way it lies from the position (e.g. 0.5 NM SW), its nights, where it is, its page and its place on the map. With a wind, each place gets its nights in that wind, split by strength, with the gusts on those nights (kt), and the list is sorted by those nights. A wind is counted as the site counts it: its compass point at 10 or 20 kt or more, as the forecast's band (e.g. wind_kn 15 counts E 10 kt or more). wind_from alone counts the direction at any strength. Under 3 kt (wind_kn in whole knots) the wind has no settled direction, so every night counts. A night counts once, in the wind it blew from most. Tonight is counted as the site's Tonight counts it: tonight's forecast times that are night there, each counted in its compass point at 10 or 20 kt or more, as its band (every night under 3 kt), and each place's fewest nights in any one of them. Where a place faces open water and tonight's swell there is 0.5 m or more, the nights of that count that also had that swell are given beside it, as on the site. The swell never changes the count. Places with a night in every one of tonight's winds come first, by those fewest nights, then the rest. Without a forecast, by distance. Positions are WGS84 decimal degrees.

lat.description: Latitude of the centre, WGS84 decimal degrees.

limit.description: Most places to list, 10 when left out, at most 25.

lon.description: Longitude of the centre, WGS84 decimal degrees.

radius_nm.description: Radius of the circle in nautical miles, 15 when left out, at most 50.

wind_from.description: Direction the wind blows from: degrees true (0 to 360) or a point of the 16-point compass (N, NNE, NE ... NNW).

wind_kn.description: Mean wind speed in knots (kt). Needs wind_from. Under 3 kt as whole knots the direction counts for nothing, as on the site: every night counts.

name: find_anchorages

distance.description: How far and which way from the position, as the site writes it (e.g. 0.5 NM SW).

map_url.description: The site's map opened on this place.

gusts_kt.description: Lowest and highest gust of the counted nights, kt.

nights.description: Nights boats stayed here in this wind: the site's number.

nights_by_strength.description: The nights split by the night's strongest wind from this direction, as the site's wedge for the direction. Adds up to nights.

from_10_to_20_kt.description: Null when the wind is counted at 20 kt or more.

under_10_kt.description: Null unless the wind is counted at any strength.

from.description: Null when the wind asked is under 3 kt: no settled direction, so every night counts, as on the site.

nights.description: Nights boats stayed here: the site's number.

every_window.description: Whether boats stayed here on some night in each of tonight's winds.

nights.description: The fewest nights in any one of tonight's winds.

from.description: Null when the wind asked is under 3 kt: no settled direction, so every night counts, as on the site.

weakest.description: The wind those nights are counted in.

with_swell.description: Of those nights, the ones that also had tonight's forecast swell there in that time, as the site says it beside the count: the swell's compass point, the height it is counted from, m (0.5, 1.25 or 2.5 m or more), and the nights. Null: no swell to say (a place with no open water that side, tonight's swell there under 0.5 m, or no nights in that wind).

about.description: The page that explains how the figures are known.

credit.description: The forecast's credit. Show its text, linked to its url, wherever this forecast is shown.

missing.description: Tonight's forecast times without a wind.

windows.description: Tonight's 3-hour forecast times that are night at the position, in time order.

counted_in.description: The wind its nights are counted in: its compass point at 10 or 20 kt or more, as its band; no point under 3 kt.

from.description: Null when the wind asked is under 3 kt: no settled direction, so every night counts, as on the site.

mean_kt.description: The forecast mean wind, whole kt.

time.description: The forecast time on the clock at the position, ISO with its offset.

tonight.description: Tonight's forecast at the position, null when it isn't available.

from.description: Null when the wind asked is under 3 kt: no settled direction, so every night counts, as on the site.
